evidence.title: Music legend slams LA festival after woman's body allegedly left in the crowd following her death

occurrences.checkable_against: Carson Jazz Festival production and performance records
occurrences.quote_span: "We were thinking, it's so hot outside ... maybe people were dehydrated, and we could see that through the window of the dressing room," she said. "We never got our sound check, so things were running late. Production wasn't there, stuff was just happening."
occurrences.speaker: Sheila E.
occurrences.subject: Shari Sanders

occurrences.checkable_against: Carson Jazz Festival body-removal, performance and emergency-response timelines
occurrences.quote_span: Little did we know, that after we were done performing, we went back to the dressing room, we were then told at 5 p.m. – we were done around 4:30 – they had just picked up her body.
occurrences.speaker: Sheila E.
occurrences.subject: Shari Sanders

occurrences.checkable_against: Carson Jazz Festival founding and operating records
occurrences.quote_span: "Carson City, you need to do better ... They've been bragging about that they've been doing it for 40 years, but this is not good to have people sitting outside for three hours to be able to come to a festival."
occurrences.speaker: Sheila E.
occurrences.subject: Shari Sanders

occurrences.checkable_against: Carson Jazz Festival incident records and official death investigation
occurrences.quote_span: "We were all heartbroken because that's never happened, to have someone pass away before ... and it was outside," she noted. "It was at the park."
occurrences.speaker: Sheila E.
occurrences.subject: Shari Sanders

occurrences.checkable_against: Sheila E.'s social media posts or statements and festival witness accounts
occurrences.quote_span: Sheila admitted that she, along with the band, prayed for the woman before going on stage.
occurrences.speaker: Fox News Digital
occurrences.subject: Shari Sanders

occurrences.checkable_against: Carson Jazz Festival emergency dispatch and response timeline
occurrences.quote_span: "Then that lead to, you know, people coming and trying to find out what's going on," she said. "We then saw paramedics, but this was like 20 minutes later."
occurrences.speaker: Sheila E.
occurrences.subject: Shari Sanders

occurrences.checkable_against: Carson Jazz Festival venue maps, hydration-station inventory and attendee reports
occurrences.quote_span: "The devastating part is she passed away," Sheila said before relaying that she heard there was minimal access to hydration stations throughout the venue.
occurrences.speaker: Sheila E.
occurrences.subject: Shari Sanders

occurrences.checkable_against: Carson Jazz Festival performance recording and witness accounts
occurrences.quote_span: "I stopped after the first song and dedicated the show to her and her family, and had a moment of silence for her," she said.
occurrences.speaker: Sheila E.
occurrences.subject: Shari Sanders

occurrences.checkable_against: Carson Jazz Festival incident and venue records
occurrences.quote_span: Sheila E. slammed festival organizers following the death of a woman at the concert whose body was allegedly left in the crowd until after her performance.
occurrences.speaker: Fox News Digital
occurrences.subject: Shari Sanders

occurrences.checkable_against: Lula Davis-Holmes statement and City of Carson communications
occurrences.quote_span: "On behalf of the City, I extend our deepest condolences to the family, loved ones, and everyone affected by this tragedy," she wrote. "I have personally reached out and have spoken to the family during this painful time, and I ask our entire community to join me in keeping them in your prayers – surrounding them with strength, comfort, and peace during this unimaginable moment."
occurrences.speaker: Lula Davis-Holmes
occurrences.subject: Shari Sanders

occurrences.checkable_against: Lula Davis-Holmes social-media statement
occurrences.quote_span: In a statement shared on social media, Mayor Lula Davis-Holmes wrote that "hearts are heavy following the tragic loss of a life at our community event."
occurrences.speaker: Lula Davis-Holmes
occurrences.subject: Shari Sanders

occurrences.checkable_against: National Weather Service temperature records for Southern California and Carson event records
occurrences.quote_span: The musician explained that it was "very hot that day" with temperatures soaring above 100 degrees in Southern California.
occurrences.speaker: Sheila E.
occurrences.subject: Shari Sanders

occurrences.checkable_against: Carson Jazz Festival death and incident records
occurrences.quote_span: The legendary musician admitted she was heartbroken upon hearing how Shari Sanders died at the Carson Jazz Festival amid sweltering temperatures over the weekend in Southern California.
occurrences.speaker: Fox News Digital
occurrences.subject: Shari Sanders

occurrences.checkable_against: Carson Jazz Festival gate-opening and attendance records
occurrences.quote_span: When we got there at 7:30 a.m., people were already in line sitting in their chairs waiting to get in," she said before noting that organizers opened the grounds 30 minutes early to let attendees in.
occurrences.speaker: Sheila E.
occurrences.subject: Shari Sanders
